create_AgentFrameworkConfig_from_flags: create an AgentFrameworkConfig from agentic flags with optional user overrides using the create class method
create_AgentFrameworkConfig_with_default: create an AgentFrameworkConfig dataclass instance with all default values for the Safari agent framework
serialize_AgentFrameworkConfig_to_dict: serialize an AgentFrameworkConfig instance to a flat dictionary of string values for logging session labels
